entities.summary: Joseph Heintz the Younger or Joseph Heintz (II) (1600 – 24 September 1678) was a German Baroque painter. In 1625 he travelled to Italy, where he settled in Venice and became known for his copies of his father's work and his religious or mythological paintings.
